high_level_description: The image is a digital screenshot of a news headline from ANI (Associated Press of India). The headline reads: "NSE/BSE market cap to cross USD 10 trillion by 2030 - Experts" This headline suggests that according to experts, the combined market capitalization of the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) will surpass $10 trillion by the year 2030. Below the headline, there is additional information indicating the source and the update time: Source: ANI Updated: May 24, 2024
